frames: absolute C frame numbers (the delivered f_%05d.jpg names)

basis_labels.MEASURED: a pixel statistic decided the frame(s) (see method)
basis_labels.OBSERVED: checked by eye on native-resolution stills (never in motion)
basis_labels.INFERRED: not used for any frame in this table

sync_definitions.catch: a fire catching: first = the first frame its flame is visible, fastest = its fastest growth, full = 90% of its size; a sound's burst ARRIVES on first..fastest, a score's resolution on full
sync_definitions.ramp: a gradual change: first/half/full = 10%/50%/90% of the way
sync_definitions.ink: a drawing stroke: frames where ink arrives (a pen/quill sound follows them)
